title: FLUX.3 Image Klein Base on 2xH200
description: First benchmark of FLUX.3 Image (black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-base, text-to-image, 1024x1024, 50 steps, CFG 3.5) in this repo, on one 2xH200 rx devbox, with a three-way two-GPU layout sweep (CFG parallel / TP2 / Ulysses-2). Single-framework: no other tracked framework serves FLUX.3 on its main line yet.

benchmark_repo.runner: scripts/devbox_run_cases.sh (run_comparison --modes single_e2e); layout sweep with scripts/tune_sglang_serve_args.sh

runtime.note: FLUX.3 Image support landed in sglang on 2026-10-15 (sgl-project/sglang#44418). The lmsysorg/sglang:latest image (baa9bef, 2026-10-13) predates it, so sglang ran from a main checkout via DBF_SGLANG_PYTHONPATH; the result records that commit.

workload.prompt: A futuristic cyberpunk city at night, neon lights reflecting on wet streets
workload.note: The Base settings sglang's FLUX.3 cookbook validated. The step-distilled flux-3-image-klein is not used: a reduced-step model is a lossy substitute under this repo's policy.

policy.latency_source: client-side single_e2e latency_s, median of 5 measured requests after warmup
policy.torch_compile: off (sglang compile-off policy); eager, as the cookbook recommends
policy.precision: native BF16 checkpoint; no FP8R/NVFP4 variant, no quantized attention (FlashAttention selected by the runtime)
policy.placement: all components resident (--performance-mode speed); the runtime's auto policy would layerwise-offload the text encoder even with 139 GiB free
policy.hardware: one rx devbox, 2x H200 141 GB (h200-sci-k8s-1), not CI/runner/build infrastructure
policy.cross_framework: none: vLLM-Omni, LightX2V, TensorRT-LLM VisualGen, ComfyUI and FastVideo have no FLUX.3 pipeline on main (checked 2026-10-15)

frameworks.comfyui: unsupported (no FLUX.3 model or official workflow, 2026-10-15)

files.raw/run_flux3h200_flux3_klein_base_t2i_1: the formal single_e2e run with the pinned profile -- the number the summary publishes
files.raw/tune/tune_*.json: the layout sweep, 3 interleaved rounds x 3 arms, run_comparison output per arm

reproduce: scripts/tune_sglang_serve_args.sh flux3_klein_base_t2i_1024 3 'cfg=ENV:PYTHONPATH=<sglang>/python:src' 'tp2=--tp-size 2 --enable-cfg-parallel false ENV:PYTHONPATH=<sglang>/python:src' 'uly2=--enable-cfg-parallel false --ulysses-degree 2 ENV:PYTHONPATH=<sglang>/python:src'  (DBF_HARDWARE_PROFILE=h200 TUNE_PORT_BASE=61000)
DBF_FRAMEWORKS=sglang DBF_HARDWARE_PROFILE=h200 DBF_SGLANG_PYTHONPATH=<sglang>/python scripts/devbox_run_cases.sh flux3h200 0,1 61200 single_e2e flux3_klein_base_t2i_1024
